question: Varun invests a sum of ₹5400 and Ashish invests a sum of ₹9400 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 3 years, Ashish gets ₹960 more interest than Varun, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in principal = ₹9400 − ₹5400 = ₹4000

Difference in interest for 3 years = ₹960

Difference in interest for 1 year = 960 ÷ 3 = ₹320

Rate% = (Interest difference for 1 year ÷ Principal difference) × 100

Rate% = (320 ÷ 4000) × 100 = 8%

**∴ The correct answer is 8%.**
